reply.text: Holt here. DMAA is a stimulant that was pulled from supplements years ago because of serious cardiovascular risks, and I wouldn't take it or recommend it. If you're thinking about any preworkout, the label's ingredient list and a conversation with a doctor are the right place to start, and I can't give you an amount for any stimulant or supplement. What I can do is help you get more out of your sessions without one: sleep, a solid warm-up, and a steady progression on your main lifts usually move the needle more than a scoop of anything. Want me to pull up your recent training so we can see where you're at?
